subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft (owners + target close)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Hsu <dani.hs@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft (owners + target close)

Hi Danielle — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery: 

- Objective: Evaluate Redwood Inference for production LLM inference for patient triage summaries (initial PoC -> prod).
- Target close: customer-signed contract by end of July 2027 (tentative).
- Proposed PoC scope: 3 models (summarization, PII redaction, lightweight reranking), sample throughput 30 req/s.
- Key dependencies: Security questionnaire completion (SOC2 evidence), network setup for VPC peering, sample dataset for validation (anonymized).

Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestones, owners, and a proposed timeline (Orchid_MAP_v1.0.xlsx). Please review owners and any missing dependencies. I called out two items for your team to confirm: procurement timeline and legal review window.

Can you confirm: 1) who on your side owns procurement? 2) whether July 29 is a realistic target for an executed order?

Thanks — I’ll iterate the MAP based on your notes.

Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
[Attachment: Orchid_MAP_v1.0.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Danielle Hsu <dani.hs@orchidhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@orchidhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (owners + target close)

Thanks Marcus — helpful recap. A few notes inline: 

- Procurement owner: cc'd procurement@orchidhealth.com (lead: Javier Morales). They'll handle SOW and PO cadence.
- Legal: small-team review, likely 2–3 weeks once SOW is finalized; expect some standard security redlines.
- Dependencies: we need a shortened security evidence pack (SOC2 summary + encryption details) — can you share that?

On the MAP: I reviewed Orchard_MAP_v1.0 quickly and flagged two items: data retention (we require 30 day rolling KV cache purge by policy) and a network requirement for IP allowlist (we prefer static egress). I attached our internal risk sheet with comments.

Two asks for you: 
1) please update the MAP owners for technical validation to show Monica as Redwood's PoC for PoC setup.
2) push the target close to Aug 5 on our side until procurement confirms PO timeline (we prefer buffer).

I'll coordinate procurement availability next week.

— Danielle
Director of Product | Orchid Health
dani.hs@orchidhealth.com
[Attachment: Orchid_Risk_Questions.pdf (application/pdf)]

Danielle / Javier — thanks for the fast feedback. I updated the MAP to reflect the items you called out: Monica is now the technical owner for PoC setup and validation, data retention row updated to 30-day purge, and a network requirements note added for static IPs. New file attached: Orchid_MAP_v1.1.xlsx.

High-level changes: 
- PoC kickoff: week of June 21 (Monica leads Redwoods engineering onboarding).
- Security evidence: sent to your procurement + legal; summary attached here and I'll share the full SOC2 report in our secure drive link.
- Target close: provisional Aug 5, 2027 per your ask — mark as "customer-confirm" until procurement confirms PO date.

Outstanding blocks (actions):
1) Procurement to confirm PO window and any required SOW language (Owner: Procurement Team) — due Jun 18.
2) Orchid to provide anonymized sample dataset for validation (Owner: Danielle) — due Jun 25.
3) Redwood to provide SOC2 summary + encryption details (Owner: Marcus) — due Jun 9 (sent to drive).

I will run weekly MAP check-ins starting next Monday to keep milestones visible. If any owners change, please flag here so I can update the document.

Marcus Lin

Quick nudge on the MAP owners/actions: 

- Procurement confirmation (Procurement Team) — was due Jun 18 per MAP; can you confirm if that date still holds or if we should move it?
- Sample dataset (Danielle) — deadline Jun 25; if you need more time, please propose new date so PoC schedule can shift.

If we don't get procurement visibility by Jun 18 we'll need to delay PoC kickoff to the week of Jun 28 to keep engineering capacity predictable. Happy to jump on a 20-minute call to unblock.

Thanks — Neha
